SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,PRICE,BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,MEMPRICE FROM ( SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE, CASE SUBCATEGORY WHEN '61' THEN DISKCAPACITY ELSE PRICE END AS PRICE,'' BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,to_char(DISKCAPACITY) MEMPRICE FROM res_config_combo WHERE STATUS = '2' AND PRICE <> 0 AND (CATEGORY = '2' OR SUBCATEGORY ='61') UNION ALL SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,PRICE,'' BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,to_char(DISKCAPACITY) MEMPRICE FROM res_config_combo WHERE STATUS = '2' AND CATEGORY IN ('5') AND ((SUBCATEGORY='51' and DEVOPSLEVEL=#{sysOperLevel} AND ISRELATEFUND=#{isFundTrans}) or SUBCATEGORY='52' or (SUBCATEGORY='51' and ISSPECIAL='1')) UNION ALL SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CASE WHEN TYPE IN ('9','10') THEN '11' ELSE TYPE END AS CATEGORY, SUBTYPE AS SUBCATEGORY, '' AS APPLYSCENE, SOFTNAME || ' ' || SOFTVERSION AS DESCRIBE,PRICE,BILLINGMODE,'' RATIO,'' ISSPECIAL,'' MEMPRICE FROM RES_CONFIG_SOFT WHERE status = '2' AND TYPE IN ('7', '8', '9', '10') AND PRICE <> 0 )
WHERE ID NOT IN
#{item}
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(CATEGORY), TO_NUMBER(SUBCATEGORY)

SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,PRICE,BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,MEMPRICE FROM ( SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, '4' CATEGORY, TO_CHAR(TYPE) as SUBCATEGORY, '' APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,PRICE,'' BILLINGMODE,'' RATIO,'' ISSPECIAL,'' MEMPRICE FROM RES_CONFIG_VM WHERE STATUS = '2' UNION ALL SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,PRICE,'' BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,to_char(DISKCAPACITY) MEMPRICE FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO WHERE STATUS = '2' AND CATEGORY in ('5') AND SUBCATEGORY <> '51' AND PRICE <> 0 AND ((SUBCATEGORY='51' and DEVOPSLEVEL=#{sysOperLevel} AND ISRELATEFUND=#{isFundTrans}) OR SUBCATEGORY='52' OR (SUBCATEGORY='51' AND ISSPECIAL='1')) UNION ALL SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,DISKCAPACITY AS PRICE,'' BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,to_char(DISKCAPACITY) MEMPRICE FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO WHERE STATUS = '2' AND SUBCATEGORY = '61' UNION ALL SELECT ISCANCEL, ID, CASE WHEN TYPE IN ('9','10') THEN '11' ELSE TYPE END AS CATEGORY, SUBTYPE AS SUBCATEGORY, '' as APPLYSCENE, SOFTNAME || ' ' || SOFTVERSION AS DESCRIBE,PRICE,BILLINGMODE,'' RATIO,'' ISSPECIAL,'' MEMPRICE FROM RES_CONFIG_SOFT WHERE STATUS = '2' AND TYPE IN ('7', '8', '9', '10') AND PRICE <> 0 )
WHERE ID NOT IN
#{item}
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(CATEGORY), TO_NUMBER(SUBCATEGORY)

SELECT ISCANCEL,ID, CATEGORY, SUBCATEGORY, APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE,DISKCAPACITY AS PRICE,'' BILLINGMODE,RATIO,ISSPECIAL,to_char(DISKCAPACITY) MEMPRICE FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO WHERE STATUS = '2' AND SUBCATEGORY = '61'
AND ID NOT IN
#{item}
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(CATEGORY), TO_NUMBER(SUBCATEGORY)
SELECT DISKCAPACITY from res_config_combo where id=#{id}

with M(extenditemid,num) as (select extenditemid, TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(subcategory ||':'|| num)) from (select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as subcategory, sum(case when t.subcategory = '61' then 1 else t.num end) as num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') n on t.subcategory = n.dictid where t.category = '6' and t.extendid = #{id} group by t.extenditemid, n.dictname union all select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as subcategory, sum(t.num) as num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') n on t.subcategory = n.dictid where t.category ='2' and t.extendid = #{id} group by t.extenditemid, n.dictname union all select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as subcategory, sum(t.num) as num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_VM_TYPE%') n on t.subcategory = n.dictid where t.category ='4' and t.extendid = #{id} group by t.extenditemid, n.dictname) group by extenditemid), N(extenditemid,describe) as (select t.extenditemid,TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(t.describe)) describe from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t where t.category in ('7','8','9') and t.PRICE>0 and t.EXTENDID = #{id} group by extenditemid)
select a.Owncenter, a.restype, a.ciname, t.num as PZ, k.describe DESCRIBE from RES_EXTEND_ITEM a left join M t on t.extenditemid = a.id left join N k on k.extenditemid = a.id where a.extendid=#{id} order by a.Owncenter

WITH M AS ( SELECT t.EXTENDITEMID, n.DICTNAME as SUBCATEGORY, SUM(t.NUM) as NUM FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY') n ON t.SUBCATEGORY = n.DICTID WHERE t.CATEGORY = '2' AND t.EXTENDID = #{id} GROUP BY t.EXTENDITEMID, n.DICTNAME UNION ALL SELECT t.EXTENDITEMID, n.DICTNAME as SUBCATEGORY, SUM(t.NUM) as NUM FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_VM_TYPE') n ON t.SUBCATEGORY = n.DICTID WHERE t.CATEGORY = '4' AND t.EXTENDID = #{id} GROUP BY t.EXTENDITEMID, n.DICTNAME )
SELECT a.OWNCENTER, a.CINAME, a.RESTYPE, t.SUBCATEGORY AS MODELTYPE, t.NUM AS PZ, '/' AS DESCRIBE FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM a LEFT JOIN M t ON t.EXTENDITEMID = a.ID WHERE a.EXTENDID = #{id} ORDER BY a.OWNCENTER

with M(extenditemid,num) as (select extenditemid, TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(subcategory ||':'|| num)) from (select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as subcategory, sum(case when t.subcategory = '61' then 1 else t.num end) as num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') n on t.subcategory = n.dictid where t.category = '6' and t.extendid = #{id} group by t.extenditemid, n.dictname union all select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as subcategory, sum(t.num) as num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') n on t.subcategory = n.dictid where t.category ='2' and t.extendid = #{id} group by t.extenditemid, n.dictname union all select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as subcategory, sum(t.num) as num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_VM_TYPE%') n on t.subcategory = n.dictid where t.category ='4' and t.extendid = #{id} group by t.extenditemid, n.dictname) group by extenditemid), N(extenditemid,DES) as (select extenditemid,TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DES)) from (select extenditemid, subcategory || ':' || to_char(sum(num),'fm999999999999990.99') || 'G' AS DES from (select t.extenditemid,n.dictname as category, case when t.isspecial = '1' then '归档数据' else m.dictname end as subcategory, t.num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category = n.dictid where t.category in ('5') and t.EXTENDID = #{id} union all select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as category, '归档数据' as subcategory, t.sanrelatenum from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category = n.dictid where t.category in ('5') and t.isspecial = '0' and t.subcategory = '51' and t.EXTENDID = #{id} union all select t.extenditemid, n.dictname as category, 'ORACLE云存储' as subcategory, t.num from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category = n.dictid where t.category in ('6') and t.subcategory = '61' and t.EXTENDID = #{id}) group by extenditemid, subcategory) group by extenditemid)
select a.Owncenter, a.restype, a.ciname, t.num as PZ, k.DES DESCRIBE from RES_EXTEND_ITEM a left join M t on t.extenditemid = a.id left join N k on k.extenditemid = a.id where a.extendid=#{id} order by a.Owncenter

WITH N AS ( SELECT t.EXTENDITEMID, t.describe, CASE WHEN t.ISSPECIAL = '1' THEN '归档数据' ELSE m.DICTNAME END AS SUBCATEGORY, t.NUM FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY') m ON t.SUBCATEGORY = m.DICTID WHERE t.CATEGORY IN ('5') AND t.EXTENDID = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT t.EXTENDITEMID, t.DESCRIBE, '归档数据' as SUBCATEGORY, t.SANRELATENUM FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY') m ON t.SUBCATEGORY = m.DICTID WHERE t.CATEGORY in ('5') AND t.ISSPECIAL = '0' AND t.SUBCATEGORY = '51' AND t.EXTENDID = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT t.EXTENDITEMID, t.DESCRIBE, 'ORACLE云存储' AS SUBCATEGORY, t.NUM FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY') m ON t.SUBCATEGORY = m.DICTID WHERE t.CATEGORY IN ('6') AND t.SUBCATEGORY = '61' AND t.EXTENDID = #{id} )
SELECT a.OWNCENTER, a.RESTYPE, a.CINAME, k.SUBCATEGORY AS MODELTYPE, k.DESCRIBE AS PZ, K.NUM AS DESCRIBE FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM a LEFT JOIN N k ON k.EXTENDITEMID = a.ID WHERE a.EXTENDID = #{id} ORDER BY a.OWNCENTER

select * from ( select A.Owncenter,n.dictname as category,m.dictname as subcategory, t.describe, t.price,sum(t.num) as num,sum(t.totalprice) as totalprice from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category=n.dictid left join RES_EXTEND_ITEM a on a.id = t.extenditemid where t.category in ('2') and t.EXTENDID = #{id} group by A.Owncenter,n.dictname,m.dictname,t.describe,t.price union select A.Owncenter,n.dictname as category,m.dictname as subcategory, t.describe, t.price,sum(t.num) as num,sum(t.totalprice) as totalprice from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_VM_TYPE%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category=n.dictid left join RES_EXTEND_ITEM a on a.id = t.extenditemid where t.category in ('4') and t.EXTENDID = #{id} group by A.Owncenter,n.dictname,m.dictname,t.describe,t.price
) order by Owncenter,category

select * from ( select A.Owncenter, n.dictname as category, m.dictname as subcategory, t.describe, t.price, sum(t.num) as num, sum(t.totalprice-(case when t.sanrelatetotalprice is null then 0 else t.sanrelatetotalprice end )) as totalprice from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category = n.dictid left join RES_EXTEND_ITEM a on a.id = t.extenditemid where t.category in ('5') and t.isspecial = '0' and t.EXTENDID = #{id} group by a.Owncenter, n.dictname, m.dictname, t.describe, t.price union all select t.Owncenter, t.category, t.subcategory, t.describe, t.price, sum(t.num) as num, sum(t.totalprice) as totalprice from (select A.Owncenter, n.dictname as category, m.dictname as subcategory, '归档数据' as describe, t.sanrelateprice as price, t.sanrelatenum as num, t.sanrelatetotalprice as totalprice from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category = n.dictid left join RES_EXTEND_ITEM a on a.id = t.extenditemid where t.category in ('5') and t.subcategory='51' and t.isspecial = '0' and t.EXTENDID = #{id} union all select A.Owncenter, n.dictname as category, m.dictname as subcategory, '归档数据' as describe, t.price as price, t.num as num, t.totalprice as totalprice from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category = n.dictid left join RES_EXTEND_ITEM a on a.id = t.extenditemid where t.category in ('5') and t.subcategory='51' and t.isspecial = '1' and t.EXTENDID = #{id}) t group by t.Owncenter, t.category, t.subcategory, t.describe, t.price
union all select A.Owncenter,'ORACLE云存储' as category,m.dictname as subcategory, t.describe, t.memprice as price ,sum(t.num) as num,sum(t.memtotalprice) as totalprice from RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like 'RES_SUBCATEGORY%') m on t.subcategory = m.dictid left join (select * from eos_dict_entry t where t.dicttypeid like'RES_CATEGORY%') n on t.category=n.dictid left join RES_EXTEND_ITEM a on a.id = t.extenditemid where t.category in ('6') and t.subcategory='61' and t.EXTENDID = #{id} group by A.Owncenter,n.dictname,m.dictname,t.describe,t.memprice ) order by Owncenter

SELECT A.Owncenter, n.DICTNAME as CATEGORY, m.DICTNAME as SUBCATEGORY, t.DESCRIBE, t.PRICE, SUM(t.NUM) AS NUM, SUM(t.TOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM( SELECT CASE WHEN t.CATEGORY IN ('9','10') THEN '11' ELSE t.category END AS CATEGORY, t.SUBCATEGORY, t.DESCRIBE, t.PRICE, t.NUM, t.TOTALPRICE, t.EXTENDITEMID, t.EXTENDID FROM RES_EXTEND_ITEM_PARTS t WHERE t.CATEGORY in ('7', '8', '9', '10') AND t.EXTENDID = #{id} AND t.PRICE > 0 ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.dicttypeid = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY' ) m ON t.SUBCATEGORY = m.DICTID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY t WHERE t.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_CATEGORY' ) n ON t.CATEGORY = n.DICTID LEFT JOIN res_extend_item a ON a.ID = t.EXTENDITEMID GROUP BY a.OWNCENTER, n.DICTNAME, m.DICTNAME, t.DESCRIBE, t.PRICE ORDER BY a.owncenter

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO WHERE ISCANCEL = '1' AND ID = #{id} UNION SELECT ID, SOFTNAME || ' ' || SOFTVERSION AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_CONFIG_SOFT WHERE ISCANCEL = '1' AND ID = #{id} UNION SELECT ID, n.DICTNAME || '(' || m.DESCRIBE || ')' AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_CONFIG_VM m LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY n ON m.TYPE = n.DICTID WHERE n.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_VM_TYPE' AND m.ISCANCEL = '1' AND m.ID = #{id} ) a
